recommendation: Keep the audit commit. If a future work group wants the generated registry's per-resource sections compressed to a single inherited-parameters row, treat that as a publisher/rendering enhancement rather than a correction to the core SearchParameter definitions.
issue_request: FHIR-38999 was a Published FHIR-core R5 change request resolved Persuasive with Modification. It requested eliminating resource-specific instantiations of interface SearchParameters, ensuring MetadataResource resources get CanonicalResource search parameters, and making the shared parameters clear in the search parameter registry.
initial_application: Git commit 6c4526c5e03f2ec90cc8d0a5f62d89e3812e76dc explicitly applied FHIR-38999 by removing the old conformance-* common SearchParameter block from source/searchparameter/common-search-parameters.xml. Current source keeps CanonicalResource and MetadataResource as active interface resources and provides interface search parameter bundles that feed shared generated SearchParameters.
additional_context: MetadataResource currently templates from and derives from CanonicalResource, and the current generated CI artifacts contain shared CanonicalResource-status and MetadataResource-effective definitions with no ActivityDefinition-status, ActorDefinition-status, or conformance-status definitions. The generated registry has CanonicalResource and MetadataResource shared sections at the top and concrete resource sections use those shared ids. Follow-up Jira and community searches found no later contradictory decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source files were changed because the current built specification already publishes the shared interface SearchParameter definitions and resource search support points at those shared ids.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue requesting interface SearchParameters be represented as shared/common definitions rather than resource-specific instantiations.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final work-group intent for CanonicalResource and MetadataResource search parameter inheritance.

evidence_items.summary: FHIR-I minutes record the FHIR-38999 Persuasive with Mod motion by Josh Mandel and Grahame Grieve.
evidence_items.learned: The meeting record corroborates the Jira resolution and does not narrow or reverse it.

evidence_items.summary: Commit titled 'FHIR-38999 Interface search parameter definitions are not common' removed the conformance-* common SearchParameter block from source/searchparameter/common-search-parameters.xml.
evidence_items.learned: The issue was deliberately applied in source before this reconciliation.

evidence_items.summary: Current source declares canonicalresource and metadataresource as active interface resources, with MetadataResource templated from and based on CanonicalResource.
evidence_items.learned: MetadataResource-based concrete resources inherit the CanonicalResource search parameter family through current source wiring.

evidence_items.summary: Interface bundles define CanonicalResource-* and MetadataResource-* SearchParameters such as CanonicalResource-status and MetadataResource-effective.
evidence_items.learned: The current source has shared interface SearchParameter inputs available to the publisher.

evidence_items.summary: CI output has no ActivityDefinition-status, ActorDefinition-status, or conformance-status SearchParameter definitions, while CanonicalResource-status and MetadataResource-effective are present and the registry has shared CanonicalResource/MetadataResource sections.
evidence_items.learned: The current built specification exposes shared interface definitions rather than duplicate resource-specific SearchParameters.
